name: Hydra Market
description: Hydra was the world's largest Russian-language dark web marketplace, founded in 2015, facilitating drug trafficking, money laundering through cryptocurrency tumbling, falsified documents, and hacking services. At peak, Hydra generated over $1.3 billion in annual revenue. American and German law enforcement seized the platform in April 2022 and seized $25 million in Bitcoin. Hydra's operator was sentenced to life in prison by a Russian court in December 2024.
